heuristics.complexity: High for bvh/custom-renderer/gpgpu/physics/postprocessing/shader/ssgi/ssr/webgpu tags or 5+ related libraries; medium for 4+ tags or 4+ related libraries; low otherwise. This is a metadata triage estimate, not a runtime or code-size measure.
heuristics.input: Mapped only from upstream tags: interaction/events/raycast/selection/annotations/autofocus => pointer; scroll => scroll; audio => audio; controls/game => unspecified controls; no match => not-tagged.
heuristics.renderer: r3f when @react-three/fiber appears in runtime dependencies or related libraries; vanilla-three when only a three.js runtime is declared; otherwise other-or-unknown.
heuristics.runnable: Included when an example has pmndrs.json, package.json, and a non-empty package scripts.dev command; this does not mean each example was built or run.
heuristics.vanilla_portability: R3F entries require adaptation to vanilla Three.js; vanilla-three entries are already native; unknown renderer entries are unclassified.
